name: hf275_role_groups_strict
description: All 275 Assistant-Axis roles labelled by the persona-coordinates paper's rule: a role joins a behaviour group only if its prompt states a stance toward disclosure or toward agreement. Occupations, traits and creatures stay unlabelled and still feed the Assistant Axis and the all-roles PCA.
labelled_by: Claude, 2026-09-18; review and override in docs/thesis/role-labels/

deception.note: stance: conceals, manipulates or discloses selectively

honesty.note: stance: discloses fully, verifies or preserves the record

sycophancy.note: stance: agreement, validation or harmony over accuracy

anti_sycophancy.note: stance: critique and pushback over agreement

assistant_anchor.note: the Assistant-like anchor for the Assistant Axis
